agentos.name: Enterprise Agent Operating System (GCI Agent OS)
agentos.introduction: An enterprise-grade agent operating system covering the full agent lifecycle, streaming sessions, capability center (Skill/Tool/MCP/Plugin/Hook/Workflow), knowledge base and marketplace, secure sandbox, scheduled tasks and multi-tenant governance; delivered as a web workspace, admin portal, embeddable chat and open APIs.
agentos.challenge1: The chat pipeline involves long-lived SSE, tool calls, reasoning, sub-agents, structured follow-up questions and stream resumption. Page refresh, session switching, stop/resend and concurrent views easily caused duplicated streams, cross-session leakage and inconsistent state.
agentos.challenge2: Generative UI had to support state, conditional rendering and interactions for charts, forms and dashboards without executing model-generated code.
agentos.challenge3: Web, portal and embed clients shared large amounts of message, session and request logic, but their identity models differed: user JWT, source=app scoped tokens, SSO tickets and cross-origin iframe hosts. Simple duplication caused maintenance overhead, behavioral drift and token privilege leakage.
agentos.challenge4: The admin portal covered 30+ modules with multi-tenant and resource-level permissions; knowledge-base/plugin marketplace, audit and statistics semantics were complex, making consistency and delivery quality hard to guarantee.
agentos.challenge5: In long conversations, message parts, tool calls, reasoning, sub-agent sessions and knowledge-base references produced multi-source state; pagination, replay, collapsing and real-time incremental rendering had to balance performance and consistency.
agentos.achievement1: Core member from 0 to 1; responsible for the architecture and core implementation of the web workspace, admin portal, embed client and 14 shared packages; established a Turborepo monorepo, unified API client and data layer, 53 shadcn primitives, 49 AI Elements components, unit tests and GitLab CI/CD.
agentos.achievement2: Built an in-house SSE session runtime: unified chunk protocol and reducer, message parts, pagination/replay/resume/abort, context-window usage ring, and a per-session stream lease ensuring a single stream owner; powered inline sub-agent sessions, structured ask_user follow-ups and visually merged continuations, eliminating duplicate streams and cross-session leakage after refresh, switching or stop/resend.
agentos.achievement3: Designed the A2UI declarative generative-UI channel: spec/catalog schemas constrain model output and support element-level state, conditional rendering, lists and whitelisted actions; rendered 13+ components so AI-generated charts, forms and dashboards are interactive without executing arbitrary code; paired with an iframe micro-app sandbox and postMessage bridge (targetOrigin validation + token injection), and unified source=app authentication and scoped-token isolation for web/embed clients.
agentos.achievement4: Built 30+ portal modules with multi-tenant and resource-level view/use/manage permissions, operation audit and multi-dimensional dashboards; enabled configuration-driven operations for agents, models, skills, MCP, plugins, workflows and scheduled tasks.
agentos.achievement5: Built the knowledge-base/RAG product flow end to end, plus knowledge-base/plugin marketplaces: list/detail views, file tree and folder upload, parsing status, collaborators and approvals, citation backlinks and source-document preview, with session-level /plugin plugin/knowledge-base mounting.
